title: Day, Night and the Moving Sun
summary: Earth’s rotation causes day and night, sunrise in the east, and shadows that swing round like a clock.

ib.note: Links to MYP Individuals & Societies (time zones)

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 12: Earth, Moon, and the Sun

objectives: I can explain day and night using Earth’s rotation.
I can explain why the Sun appears to rise in the east and set in the west.
I can describe how a shadow’s length and direction change during the day.
misconceptions: The Sun moves around the Earth each day.
The Sun is directly overhead at noon everywhere.
Night happens because the Sun goes behind a mountain or the sea.
